claims.text: Whisper preprocesses audio at 16 kHz and pads or trims its input to 30-second chunks.
claims.notes: SAMPLE_RATE is 16000; CHUNK_LENGTH is 30; load_audio resamples through ffmpeg and pad_or_trim defaults to N_SAMPLES. claims.text: Whisper converts audio into a log-Mel spectrogram using a 25-millisecond Fourier window and a 10-millisecond hop.
claims.notes: The Fourier window has 400 samples and the hop has 160 samples at 16000 Hz; the spectrogram is projected through Mel filters and log10 transformed. This is a source-reviewed development annotation, not a verbatim PDF quotation. The original PDF could not be downloaded in this environment; no PDF page or character offsets have been invented.
